title: ligularia yesoensis var. sutchuenensis
intro: Ligularia yesoensis var. sutchuenensis, commonly known as Chinese Fleabane, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). The health benefits of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce swelling, alleviate pain, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Chinese Fleabane include its ability to treat conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids. The bioactive constituents of Ligularia yesoensis var. sutchuenensis have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities, providing further evidence of its medicinal value.
